title: Phone voice asks get no answer while memory is low

owner_note.text: Right now every new agent waits at Servex's memory gate (1.2 GB free, the floor is 2.5 GB; 137 node processes hold 6.7 GB). So ask_mastermind from the Claude app gets its ticket and then nothing: two voice masterminds, one probably yours from 23:03Z, are stuck in the spawn queue. The bridge I'm building will say so out loud and route to an agent that's already running, so you're never waiting on a spawn.
